method.name: append
method.description: Adds [param frame] to [param peer]'s run and answers the run that must go out before it, empty when none does. [param budget] bounds an unreliable run and is ignored for a reliable one. A frame that alone exceeds the budget still rides: it opens an empty run, so there is nothing to hand back, and refusing it here would drop a frame the caller has no other way to send.

method.name: peers
method.description: Every peer holding bytes on one lane, sorted, so two flushes in one frame agree about the order they went out in.

method.name: take
method.description: Empties [param peer]'s run on the named lane and answers it.
